overview.summary: Go-to-market strategy focusing on emotional marketing, local validation, and multi-channel outreach to schools and families.
overview.philosophy: Focus on the need for improved mental health and engagement. Highlight the poor state of these in society and the need for technology and science used properly.

dualLensApproach.description: Highlight very needy schools AND top performing students while maintaining the product works for all.

emotionalAppeals.purpose: Spread ideas, tell stories, create value
Appeal to growth and positive change

keyMessages: Schools and parents need to do more to improve poor engagement and mental health
Treat this as a crisis needing immediate urgent solution
Expanse provides low cost/no cost option - no excuse not to use it
Students deserve to feel worthy of successful lives and college

localLaunch.name: KCPS & Local Knowledge Spread
localLaunch.description: Spread knowledge related to KCPS case study in local KC environment as launchpad to get into KC area schools.
tactics: Turn around KCPS, become a good school with help and good IT
Use KCPS as important data point that relates to local audience

organicPromotion.description: Effective marketing and app design should empower students, parents, and teachers to promote the app organically.
mechanisms: Features like student benefits for teacher participation
Requests for teachers to create stores

channels.name: Educational Conferences
channels.description: Industry conferences for educators and edtech

channels.name: B2B Outreach: K-12 Schools
channels.description: Direct outreach to local K-12 schools

pricing.strategy: Possibly free for schools, possibly paid - TBD
pricing.initialApproach: Free for districts, focus on families and teachers for revenue

audience.targetGrades: 6-12 and Higher Education (want to target everyone)
audience.advertisingApproach: Target social advertisements to general public and education. Direct communication to B2B connections.

productPrivacy.strategy: Keep features private initially but talk about problems and need for solutions.
productPrivacy.launchPhase: When MVP is tested, validated, and ready - begin talking about features
